From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps — Acme Corp

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery and agreed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- POC scope: evaluate Redwood inference for chat summarization pipeline (ingest ~5k msgs/day, 1K token average).
- Success criteria: 95% reduction in latency p50 vs current baseline, integration with your staging S3 + KMS, and sample-run quality tests on the prompt set.
- Timeline: target 2-week POC, proposed kickoff week of Feb 16 (flexible).

Action items
1) Jamie/Alex: Share sample data and staging access (S3 + creds) — blocker for engineering setup.
2) Acme: Review the attached SOW draft and POC checklist; confirm scope & signatures.
3) Redwood (Rafael): Technical onboarding and environment access; Rafael will do the setup/run the first end-to-end test.

I’m attaching the POC-Checklist and a SOW draft to make it easier to get started. If Feb 17 or 18 works for a short 45-min kickoff + tech session, I’ll schedule Rafael. Otherwise tell me a preferred date and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — excited to get this going.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Quick 30-min intro with Rafael this week where he’ll do the account wiring and confirm permissions (we can pair-program).
- We can run a narrow scoped smoke test if you can share a small sample dataset (5–10 files).
- Push the kickoff two weeks out if priorities have changed.

I’ve attached an onboarding calendar invite (onboarding-invite.ics) with a couple of proposed slots. If you prefer, tell me a good time and Rafael and I will lock it in.

Thanks,
Marissa
